java.lang.Object

All Implemented Interfaces:
Builder<VariantAttributesVariant>
public class VariantAttributesVariantBuilder extends Object implements Builder<VariantAttributesVariant>
VariantAttributesVariantBuilder
Example to create an instance using the builder pattern 

     VariantAttributesVariant variantAttributesVariant = VariantAttributesVariant.builder()
             .id("{id}")
             .plusAttributes(attributesBuilder -> attributesBuilder)
             .build()
